test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All dresses are clouds.

Some clouds are tables.

Some tables are stones.

**Conclusion (I):** All stones are dresses.

**Conclusion (II): **Some dresses are tables.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8788e04f6ce30be489df1f232b6bfc416700321de3eb6066d6b0da547dba36bc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All stones are dresses → Does not follow (As all dresses are clouds, some clouds are tables and some tables are stones. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some dresses are tables → Does not follow (As all dresses are clouds and some clouds are tables. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**"
